# aidial_application_type_schema (Resource)

Manages a DIAL Core custom application type schema (`PUT /v1/schemas/{bucket}/{path}`): a JSON Schema document, identified by its `$id`, that describes a custom application type.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "aidial_application_type_schema" "quick" {
  bucket = "platform"
  path   = "quick"

  schema = jsonencode({
    "$id" = "https://dial.epam.com/application_type_schemas/quick"
    type  = "object"
    properties = {
      prompt = { type = "string" }
    }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket` (String) Target DIAL bucket. Must be "platform".
- `path` (String) Application type schema path inside the target bucket.
- `schema` (String) The application type schema as a JSON object string (use `jsonencode`). Must contain a non-blank `$id`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `schema_id` (String) The `$id` of the schema.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = aidial_application_type_schema.example
  id = "platform/quick"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by <bucket>/<path>.
terraform import aidial_application_type_schema.example platform/quick
```
